faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VNIT Nagpur Electrical Safety Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Electrical Safety Officer position at VNIT Nagpur is 15 October 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Electrical Safety Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Electrical Safety Officer position at Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology Nagpur as per the current recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for the Electrical Safety Officer?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Electrical Safety Officer position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 40,000/- as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Electrical Safety Officer post at VNIT Nagpur is 35 years. Please check the official notification for any specific age relaxation rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates must prepare their application and required documents and send them to the official email address provided by the institute.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, or ST) applying for the Electrical Safety Officer post at VNIT Nagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Electrical Safety Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Electrical Safety Officer position at VNIT Nagpur involves two stages: shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Electrical Engineering with 5 years of experience or a 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 15 years of experience in the operation and maintenance of electrical installations.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Electrical Safety Officer position at VNIT Nagpur is a contractual job. The terms and conditions of the contract will be governed by the institute's recruitment policy.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Electrical Safety Officer post is at the Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT) campus located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.
